R1.description: review-plan and review-implementation can be routed to codex through the existing harness field, behind their own adapter role, with the default and every Claude record unchanged (#315)

R2.description: A routed review runs read-only through run_review inside the job's record, with one job status per ending and one test each, usage admitted on the Codex provider (#315)

R3.description: Every recovery site of a codex_review record calls recover, records nothing again and leaves no clone (#315)

R4.description: The routed path is tested adversarially through the job: credentials, symlink, submodule, hook, crafted ref, forged header, and a test for every cause of the deny set and every refusal (#315)

R5.description: An opt-in operator live proof of both stages exists and records its measured result (#315)

R6.description: The cost table and the pages state what is selectable, what a review loop costs and how it meets the weekly hold, from measured figures only (#315)
